items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: Then the Young Tuxedo band, which Doc Oynos the bass player was the band.

ctx.x: Well you came back from the war and you say then you worked with the Young Olympia first, didn't you?
Young Olympia band twice. Then the Young Tuxedo band, which Doc Oynos the bass player was the band. Freddie Babu was the trombone player.
Well I want to ask a little bit about that name, Young Tuxedo.
